answer_text:
Here are some great places where you can order a birthday cake online:

---

### 🎂 1. **Bake Me A Wish** — [bakemeawish.com](https://www.bakemeawish.com)
Bake Me A Wish! began in 2005 as the premier nationwide service for gourmet birthday cake delivery, with cakes made using only the finest, freshest ingredients by award-winning New York bakeries. They go beyond traditional vanilla and chocolate — you'll find a wide range of flavors like Tiramisu, Salted Caramel, Tres Leches, Limoncello, Boston Cream, and Coconut Cream.

---

### 🎂 2. **Milk Bar** — [milkbarstore.com](https://milkbarstore.com)
Milk Bar is best known for its playful and innovative approach to classic desserts. Their cakes have a distinctive "naked frosting" style with no outer frosting layer on the sides to showcase the layers of cake and filling, topped with cake truffles. Their iconic Birthday Cake is a funfetti-inspired vanilla cake layered with frosting and rainbow sprinkles. You can select the delivery date at checkout up to 30 days in advance, and they recommend scheduling delivery at least 3 or more days ahead of your celebration.

---

### 🎂 3. **Goldbelly** — [goldbelly.com](https://www.goldbelly.com)
Goldbelly curates a collection of delicious birthday cakes baked at the United States' most famous bakeries, including Carousel Cakes, Daisy Cakes, and We Take the Cake — all shipping nationwide, with gluten-free, kosher, nut-free, and Paleo options available.

---

### 🎂 4. **Harry & David** — [harryanddavid.com](https://www.harryanddavid.com)
Their gourmet cakes, specialty desserts, and cheesecakes are handcrafted in their Southern Oregon bakery and delivered nationwide. You can choose from rich chocolate birthday cakes, classic vanilla, and seasonal favorites, all made with premium ingredients for fresh, bakery-quality flavor.

---

### 🎂 5. **Magnolia Bakery** — [magnoliabakery.com](https://www.magnoliabakery.com)
Magnolia Bakery is a great option if you want a classic birthday cake. They take simple, classic flavors like vanilla, chocolate, and carrot cake and make them phenomenal with high-quality ingredients.

---

### 🎂 6. **Whole Foods Market** — [wholefoodsmarket.com](https://www.wholefoodsmarket.com)
From the cult-favorite Berry Chantilly Cake to the decadent Chocolate Eruption Cake, their bakery makes events memorable — and all cakes must be made with ingredients you can trust, including cage-free eggs and no hydrogenated fats or high-fructose corn syrup. Many Whole Foods Market locations offer cakes that can be ordered ahead online for easy pickup in store.

---

### 🎂 7. **Publix** — [publix.com](https://www.publix.com)
Publix hand-decorates their custom cakes in-store, and you can choose from a wide selection of themes featuring your favorite sports, TV shows, and movies — or customize a cake with your choice of flavor, filling, and icing. You can design and order your Publix cake online for in-store pickup, and if you order at least 24 hours before your event, it will be ready for you.

---

Each of these services offers something unique, whether you're looking for nationwide shipping, custom designs, or specialty flavors. Happy celebrating! 🥳
